afk2.py.summary: Report unused imports in Python files and archives, optionally rewriting them in place.
details: Collects every import statement of the scanned sources (``.py`` files plus ``.whl``/``.zip``/``.tar`` members), compares the bound names against the names actually used and prints one line per unused import. ``--autofix`` removes the unused names, ``--dry-run`` previews the edits and ``--ignore-init`` treats imports in ``__init__.py`` as re-exports.

alu.py.summary: Show the packages with pending upgrades on a Termux/apt system.
details: A one-liner wrapper around ``apt list --upgradable``, kept as a short command instead of remembering the apt invocation.
alu.py.notes: Takes no arguments and runs ``apt`` with the inherited terminal.

ans2proj.py.summary: Rebuild a project tree from a Markdown answer file.
details: Each ``## `path/to/file``` heading starts a section whose fenced code block becomes the content of that file. Relative paths are recreated below the output directory, so a pasted answer from a chat model turns back into a set of files.

archive_dir.py.summary: Archive a directory into ``.tar`` or ``.tar.gz`` and optionally delete what was archived.
details: The ``tar`` and ``tgz`` subcommands both take a folder and write an archive next to it (or to ``--output``). ``--keep`` keeps the sources, while ``--cleanup-scope`` decides whether the folder itself or only its contents are removed afterwards.

arx.py.summary: Extract archives in many formats, including nested ones.
details: Handles ``.tar``/``.tar.gz``/``.tar.xz``/``.tar.bz2``, ``.zip``, ``.7z``, ``.zst``, ``.br`` and ``.lz4`` (raw streams as well as tar containers). Integrity is checked first; archives that are found inside extracted output are picked up again so a single run can unwrap several layers.

autobuild.py.summary: Build every Python package directory below the current directory into wheels.
details: A directory counts as a package when it holds ``setup.py``, ``setup.cfg`` or ``pyproject.toml``. Wheels are written to ``./wheels`` by ``python -m build --wheel``, one worker per package, with a success/failure summary at the end.

autoclone.py.summary: Clone the GitHub repositories named in a file, skipping large or unwanted ones.
details: Reads one ``owner/repo`` per line from the file given on the command line, looks up each repository size through the GitHub API (cached for a week in ``repo_sizes.json``) and clones only the repositories no larger than 5 MB. Names containing django, flask, torch, tensor, llm or mcp are skipped. A ``GITHUB_TOKEN`` in ``~/.env`` raises the API rate limit.

autopull.py.summary: Run a fast-forward ``git pull`` in every repository under the current directory.
details: Walks the tree, detects directories containing ``.git`` and runs ``git -C <repo> pull --ff-only``, reporting repositories that need a manual merge.

b642f.py.summary: Decode the base64 lines of a file into binary files and keep only the failures in the source.
details: Every non-empty line is decoded, after stripping a leading ``base64,`` data-URI prefix when present, and written to ``<sha256>.bin``. Lines that fail are printed with their line number and left in the input file, so a repeated run continues where it stopped.

bash2py.py.summary: Extract ``python`` here-documents from shell scripts into standalone Python files.
details: Finds ``python <<EOF`` style blocks, re-indents the captured code and writes it next to the caller as ``<script>.py`` (``<script>_1.py``, ``_2`` ... when a script contains several blocks), formatting the result along the way.

bat2bash.py.summary: Convert Windows ``.bat`` scripts into executable bash scripts.
details: Translates the common batch commands (``echo``, ``cd``, ``dir``, ``del``, ``copy``, ``move``, ``ren``, ``type``, ``findstr``, ``if exist`` ...) and ``%VAR%`` variables into their shell equivalents. Every ``*.bat`` below the given directory becomes a ``*.sh`` with mode 755 and the original is removed.

bbc.py.summary: Delete Python build leftovers below the current directory.
details: Removes ``build``, ``dist`` and ``target`` directories, ``*.egg-info`` directories, stray ``PKG-INFO`` files and auto-generated ``setup.cfg`` files (the ones that only contain an empty ``[egg_info]`` section).

bcss.py.summary: Reformat CSS files in place with ``cleancss`` and report the space that was saved.
details: Runs ``cleancss --format beautify`` over the files named on the command line, or over every ``.css`` file below the current directory, and prints the size difference per file plus the total freed.

benchrmc.py.summary: Benchmark the comment/docstring stripper of ``rmc3`` on a tree of Python files.
details: Copies the discovered sources into a temporary directory, runs the ``rmc3`` transform pipeline over the copies with ``MAX_WORKERS`` processes and prints files/s, MiB/s and the error count, so the throughput of the cleaner can be measured without touching the originals.

bf_nlp.py.summary: Split a text file into sentences and words with blingfire and print the words.
details: A tiny driver for ``blingfire_compat.text_to_sentences``/``text_to_words``; the sentence list is computed as well but only the word list is printed.

bkk.py.summary: Delete every ``*.bak`` file under the current directory.
details: Walks the tree, prints each backup file relative to the current directory and unlinks it.

blink.py.summary: Remove dangling symlinks under the current directory.
details: Skips anything inside ``.git`` and reports links that point to a missing target; ``-d`` only lists them (dry run) instead of unlinking.
